_doc: Every place a shipped module reaches outside the shipped tree: an import that is not
stdlib, a declared dependency or an in-tree module, or a sys.path / dynamic-load path
derived from outside the tree root. Enforced by tests/test_import_boundary.py, which
fails on an unregistered site, a stale entry and any entry whose visibility is silent.
visibility: visible (degrade shows in a doctor row, payload field or output),
fallback (an equivalent route gives the same result), optional (an opt-in extra),
dead_code (unreachable on supported Pythons), no_degrade (nothing depends on it).
doctor_row: the doctor label that must read WARN when doctor runs with an empty HOME.

scope: shared (default; the site exists in the export and in the public repo), export-only (export only; becomes shared the moment the public repo gains the site) or public-only (the public repo only). tests/test_import_boundary.py enforces presence per tree kind. visibility_test: optional pytest node id proving the degrade; checked to exist in the tree where the site applies.

provenance: "unresolved" when a loader path at the site cannot be resolved statically (a parameter, an unmodelled call, a non-HOME environment read, a non-literal dynamic import or python -m/-c operand); required exactly when the guard finds such a path. Python subprocesses (subprocess.run/call/check_call/check_output/Popen with a list argv starting with sys.executable or python*) are path_calls under the subprocess call's name; an assignment to sys.path or to a package __path__ is the path_call "sys.path" / "<pkg>.__path__"; python -m <module> and inline -c code are checked as imports. A shipped .pth file and a shipped file that does not parse can never be registered.
